title: The depot at night
logline: The Newport depot at 4 AM, drawn from nothing: the bench under a caged bulb, the schedule case lit, the road empty, the sea a black line. The place she waited, at the hour she waited, with the waiting left out.

panels.composition: A small bus depot at night: a bench under a caged bulb, a lit schedule case, an empty road, the sea as a black line beyond, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small bus depot at night with a bench under a caged bulb, a lit schedule case and an empty road, the sea a black line beyond, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
